title: Written by hand, keys out of order
---

A human wrote this file directly in an editor and did not follow the declared order
(`title, relation:reply_to, relation:quote_to`). Under stage 1 this was the preserving-read
fixture; under one write path it is the reordering fixture. `relation:root` predates the key's
deletion and is now an undeclared key, so it is emitted after the declared ones rather than where
it sits here.
